study_design: A priori numerical planning contract test; each CLI case explicitly declares its design and group count; no observed samples.
analysis_population: Future independent biological units; the fixture contains no real biological observations.
estimand: Prespecified group1-minus-group2 planning difference, not an estimated effect.
missing_data: Declared dropout fraction is a planning assumption; no missing values are imputed.
multiplicity: The supplied alpha is already chosen for the intended test family; no automatic adjustment.
analysis_sets: A priori planning scenarios only; no manuscript inference
